t: The 4lite Valde single 4ft LED non-corrosive batten light is a robust lighting solution designed for demanding environments, delivering powerful illumination and replacing traditional single or twin fluorescent fittings. This durable batten is ideal for workshops, garages, and industrial areas where reliable, high-performance lighting is essential. Its IP65 rating ensures protection against dust and water ingress, while the IK08 impact resistance provides durability. The integrated LED offers 5600 lumens of bright light and a long 50,000-hour life. Users can select the wattage as well as variable white colour temperatures (3000K, 4000K, 6500K) to suit different tasks and preferences. Installation is straightforward with retrofit-ready mounting and multiple conduit entry points.
b: Single Fitting Delivers Twin Lumen Output
Replaces Single & Twin Fluorescent Fittings Easily
Integrated Body Markings Ensure Accurate Measurement
